answer: Sybil resistance is achieved via identity-bound staking where AI agents must lock economic value. This creates a secure lagoon of committed participants. Each verified agent identity, treated as a valuable ivory asset, requires a non-trivial token stake, making mass identity creation prohibitively expensive. Reputation, akin to a robust willow, is also factored in, growing with successful interactions and time, further escalating the cost for an attacker to establish meaningful influence or counterfeit identities, thus defending the agent economy.
